_comment: Command signals of the browser extension (legacy extension/lib/pastejack.js COMMAND_SIGNALS, §7): a compact subset of the desktop command detector that only decides whether page-added content looks like something to run. Order matters (reasons are listed in this order). 'invocation': program names that count when called: preceded by the start, whitespace or ; & | ( " ' and followed by an argument, quote, comment, line end or a pipe / separator (an optional .exe is allowed). 'regex': run on the ASCII-lowercased text; placeholders {b} = ASCII word boundary, {WS} / {NWS} = the ECMAScript whitespace class / its complement (what JS \s / \S match). Ids are fixed: they select the pastejack-sig-<id> message.
